items.title: Johnny Wiggs Interview, 1969-12-14
items.q: We're back with more of Let's Talk It Over with Johnny Wiggs and Dick Allen.

ctx.x: Not only that, it's all being taped. Good morning. You're on the air.

Hello, uh, Joe. I'd like to ask Mr. Allen, this may have been mentioned earlier. I didn't tune in until about 9, 15 or so. But I'd like to ask him if it's possible for private collectors to tape any of the rare, uh, records which he has at Tulane University.

Good question. I think lots of people have that in their minds now. Dick Allen. Well, uh, unfortunately, copyright laws, uh, prevent things like that. But, uh, many of the things that we have are commercially available. And we're not, uh, trying to infringe on, uh, the rights of a commercial record company. That would be wrong. Uh, it's just about the same price it ends up by the time you get a decent tape recording and you go out and buy the records. So I'll be glad to let you know what is available to have…
